# Certified Payments

> Certified Payments is a government payment processing platform offering multi-channel payment solutions, consumer payment lookup, and reporting services.

Certified Payments provides secure payment processing and verification services for government agencies and consumers, with a focus on bureau-based payment management and reporting portal access. The platform is operated by Accelerated Card Company, LLC in partnership with Fifth Third Bank.
